# Review Instructions

Prioritize correctness, privacy, and cross-platform reliability.

- Flag any upload, telemetry, CDN, remote script, or analytics addition.
- Flag real private data in tests or docs.
- Check Windows path handling and `file://` browser behavior.
- Verify i18n changes include PT-BR, EN, and ES updates.
- Verify parser changes include fictional fixtures.
- Verify release changes preserve semantic-release automation.
